patch_list: Writes the native ADB server's own log to /data/local/tmp/tvqa-server.log and lets its debug messages through. The server is started again every few seconds and nothing of what it says is reachable otherwise: its logger is built at a level…
Avoids preparing the ADB server main Looper twice, which otherwise prevents the server and its input endpoints from starting.

Keeps the app from stopping its own package. Stop recent apps, Restart app and Force stop app all end in `am force-stop <package>` run over ADB, and the app is in the recents list it works from, so once an ADB connection is up the app stop…

Patches the native engine libraries so that they run on a re-signed APK. The anti-tamper constructor of libd.so that destroys a global mutex is disabled, and the trap instructions the verification routine plants inside its own code - udf #…
Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, which unlocks the premium features.
